title: Flimsy, weak and wobbly
text:
Flimsy, weak and wobbly. I had hoped to use this for extra hand tools like drills, wrenches, hammers....the random detritus that collects in the garage. However, this thing is very flimsy and badly made. The shelves don't stay in place and when you do get them set and not falling down, they wobble. The whole thing wobbles empty, even on a level cement floor. It's just not sturdy.

The listing claims the rack can support a total of 150lbs, but I don't trust it with more than 15lbs. I'm keeping canned cat food and extra dog treats on it and nothing else. There are definitely better choices out there.
